title: Agora MatchCast
tagline: Add real-time Gemini captions to live sports and esports streams.
description: Build a live captioning pipeline that sends Agora RTC audio to Gemini 3.5 Transcribe and publishes the resulting captions back to viewers over an Agora data stream.
author: zicojiao

media.title: Agora MatchCast
media.summary: Caption live sports and esports with Agora RTC and Gemini transcription.
